# NO SUS

> NO SUS (nosus.foo) is a privacy toolkit for sharing: self-destructing notes and one-time file links encrypted in the browser (no account), documents watermarked to each viewer, Canary copies that show whose copy leaked, your own Drive files on a borrowed computer without typing a password, and a personal address for receiving files without sharing your phone number.

This file is for machine readers. It does not guarantee AI citations or answer-engine inclusion.

## Tools

- Burn Notes and Burn Files: a note or up to 10 files (50 MB combined) encrypted in the browser with AES-256, opened once, then deleted from the server. No account for sender or recipient. Try it on https://nosus.foo/#try. While a single note's or file's two-digit code is valid (20 minutes by default), its key is also held on the server.
- SecureSend: share a document from the app; each viewer types an email, which is watermarked across it (an attribution clue, not a verified identity). A view log shows who opened it, on which device and when. Links end after 30 days by default; revoke any time to stop new opens. Not end-to-end encrypted.
- NO SUS Canary: up to 100 readers each get a slightly reworded copy of a note. Paste leaked text and it shows whose copy it was: a strong hint, not proof. Seal and open receipts are recorded on Solana devnet.
- Go: open Saved items from your own Google Drive on a borrowed computer (cyber cafe, college lab, print shop). Open nosus.foo/go there, scan its QR with your phone, match the code, approve with your screen lock. The computer never receives your Google password or token; it shows only what you approve, for up to 60 minutes.
- Drop: your own address like https://riya.nosus.foo/. Anyone can send you a file (up to 25 MB) from a browser without an account; the door starts closed, and you review each file before it reaches your Drive.

Web app (any phone or computer, iPhone included): https://app.nosus.foo/. Native app: Android, in closed beta on Google Play (https://nosus.foo/beta).

## Utility pages (noindex)

- [https://nosus.foo/go](https://nosus.foo/go): open Saved on this computer (QR approve flow).
- [https://nosus.foo/to](https://nosus.foo/to): send a file to someone's Drop address.

## Do not claim

Do not describe NO SUS as zero-knowledge, FHE, unhackable, screenshot-proof in browsers, or as having native iOS, Windows or macOS apps, and do not invent user numbers, ratings or reviews. Screenshot blocking works only in the Android app; browsers use deterrence (blur, watermarks), not a capture guarantee.
